title: fix(objectql,lint)!: a conditional rule's `when` reads one hop through a reference, hydrated like a condition
body:
Fixes #24512

Clause-②: no (narrowing) (the save door newly refuses a `when` that reads a second hop or an undeclared related column, which today saves and then refuses every write it guards; a narrowing owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record before the queue)

Dispatched by the `domain:engine` seat 2 PM (claim 6275835421, `session_01AHeUBbe6S3JRawcpbLejXD`). The developer ran as that session's subagent. The route is triage 6265543836's: hydrate `when`.

## What changes

**Engine (`packages/objectql`, `validation/rule-validator.ts`).** No change in `engine.ts`: the engine's related read already takes its input from the collector below.

- `collectPredicateRelationships` now collects a `conditional` rule's `when`, at every depth, beside the rules it wraps. So the engine preloads a `when`'s hop through the same loader as a condition's. It uses the same system authority, the same projection, and PR #24508's per-rule handling of undeclared columns.
- `checkConditional` evaluates `when` on the scope `resolveTraversalScope` decides, the function `checkPredicate` calls. The hydrated copy belongs to the `when` alone. The branch gets the untouched context and decides its own scope, so a branch comparing the stored id still sees the id.
- The scope can refuse a `when`: a second hop, a reference read both through it and as a value, an undeclared related column, or an empty, unresolved or unreadable reference. That refusal goes through one new builder, `traversalScopeRefusal`, which `checkPredicate` now uses too. It answers `code: 'rule_violation'` with `constraint: { rule, reason: 'unevaluable', fault }`. `checkPredicate`'s message and log line are byte-identical to before.
- A `when` that faults on a delete's reference cleanup gets `referentialClearRefusal`'s text, as a condition does.

**Lint (`packages/lint`, `validate-expressions.ts`).** This is the cross-domain rider the claim declares to `domain:spec`.

- The top-level `when` and every nested predicate pass `traversalHydration`. The existing hop checks now judge a `when`: second hop, both-ways read, stored-metadata-body hop, and undeclared hop column. They run under the existing `EXPRESSION_INVALID` rule and are located at the `when` slot. No new rule, code or message.
- `RulePredicate.slot` lost its only reader and is removed.

## Measurement

### Write time

The fixture is the real `ObjectQL` engine over an in-memory driver double. A `conditional` has `when` W, `then` and `otherwise` rules that both refuse an amount over 10, and the insert has `amount: 50`. So "`then`" or "`otherwise`" names the branch that was judged.

- **Before:** `rule-validator.ts` restored from `1e8b6284c` (this PR's base); `engine.ts` is unchanged by this PR.
- **After:** this branch.
- The probe was a one-off file. It is not committed.

| W | empty reference, before | empty reference, after | partner account, before | partner account, after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `record.account.type == 'partner'` | refused, `No such key: type` | refused, "no single related record" (names the guard) | refused, `No such key: type` | **`then`** |
| `record.account != null && record.account.type == 'partner'` | `otherwise` | refused, both-ways read | refused, `No such key: type` | refused, both-ways read |
| `record.account.?type.orValue('') == 'partner'` | `otherwise` | refused, "no single related record" | `otherwise` (wrong branch, silently) | **`then`** |
| `has(record.account.type) && record.account.type == 'partner'` | `otherwise` | refused, "no single related record" | `otherwise` (wrong branch, silently) | **`then`** |
| `record.account.owner.region == 'x'` | refused, `No such key: owner` | refused, more than one hop | refused, `No such key: owner` | refused, more than one hop |
| `record.account.region == 'x'` (undeclared) | refused, `No such key: region` | refused, `'crm_account' declares no 'region'` | refused, `No such key: region` | refused, `'crm_account' declares no 'region'` |
| `record.account != null` (the guard) | `otherwise` | `otherwise` | `then` | `then` |

The "before" refusal text for every row was "The when-predicate reads 'type', which this object does not declare — fix the rule's condition, or declare the field". That sentence points the author at the wrong object.

**The runtime narrowing.** Rows 2 to 4, empty-reference column: a write that `otherwise` judged before is refused now. The `when` is judged as a `condition` reading through an empty reference has been judged since hydration landed for conditions: the verdict does not depend on which CEL operator is written. The refusal names the guard, which is a separate `when: record.account != null` with this rule nested as its `then`. This was not in the claim's measurement assumptions; see the deviations.

### Save door and build

These run `validateStackExpressions`, the pass `os validate`, `os build` and the object save door run. The fixtures pass `ObjectSchema` / `ObjectStackSchema` validation.

| `when` | before (`1e8b6284c`) | after |
|---|---|---|
| `record.account.region == 'north'` (target declares no `region`) | 0 errors | 1 `EXPRESSION_INVALID` at `validation 'gate' when`, "unknown field `region` on `hop_account`" |
| `record.account.owner.email == 'x'` | 0 errors | 1, "read through more than one relationship hop" |
| `record.account != null && record.account.status == 'active'` | 0 errors | 1, "read BOTH through the relationship", naming the guard |
| `record.account.status == 'active'` (declared) | 0 errors | 0 errors |
| `record.account != null` (the guard) | 0 errors | 0 errors |

The "before" column is the new pins run on the unfixed tree: three red, with `expected [] to deeply equal [ "object 'hop_order' · validation 'gate' when" ]`. The stored-metadata-body hop takes the same opt-in and is not separately pinned.

**Exposure in the shipped tree.** Measured at `1e8b6284c` with `git grep` outside tests: zero `when` reads through a reference. The control is the same regex with `condition` in place of `when`, which finds 8 lines, among them `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/invoice.object.ts:191`. The only `when` in `examples/` is `record.status == 'churned'`.

## Pins

- `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-relationship-traversal.test.ts`, `[#24512]` block, on the evaluator:
  - the collector names a top-level and a nested `when` hop, and nothing for the guard spelling;
  - `then` and `otherwise` are each picked on the related row, at the top level and nested;
  - the branch keeps the stored id, and the payload is not mutated;
  - the guard control;
  - a second hop and an undeclared column are refused (`code` + `constraint.rule` / `reason` / `fault`) while a sibling keeps its own verdict;
  - an empty reference names the guard;
  - a delete's cleanup is named.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-predicate-relationship.test.ts`, `[#24512]` block, on the real engine:
  - both branches on real related rows, with the `VALIDATION_FAILED` envelope and per-field `code`;
  - one system read projecting `['id', 'type']`;
  - a sibling `when` reading an undeclared column refuses alone and never enters the read.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.rule-one-hop.test.ts`, `[#24512]` block, on the build: the three refusals at the top-level and nested `when` slots, the declared read admitted, and the guard control.
- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-validation-writes.test.ts`:
  - The `#22042` per-slot pin used to assert the opt-out ("OFF for a nested `when`"). It is rewritten to assert the opt-in at both slots, top level and nested.
  - A new `#24512` block at the save door: a target from another package, a nested `when`, and the control, all asserting `rule: EXPRESSION_INVALID`.

## Ablations

Each leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor hit once and the mutation landed (blob changed). The file was restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty. The subjects are imported by relative path from `src/`, so no `dist/` is involved.

- **A** — `addFrom(r.when)` deleted from the collector: 5 red, the two collector pins and the three engine pins. Pin (a) on the real engine shows the card's defect: `Validation rule 'partner_gate' could not be evaluated (runtime: No such key: type)`.
- **B** — `checkConditional` evaluating `ctx.merged` instead of the hydrated copy: 6 red (both branch pins, nested, branch-isolation, engine branch pin, engine sibling pin).
- **C** — the `when` scope refusal replaced by `return null`: 4 red (second hop, undeclared, empty reference, engine sibling).
- **D** — the `when` cleanup text replaced by `null`: 1 red (the cleanup pin).
- **E1 / E2** — the lint opt-in reverted at the top-level `when` / the nested `when`: 5 red / 4 red.

## Verification

Final head `a8614e4116`, a merge of `origin/main` `14ccb1da9`. The incoming commits are `service-automation` and a `spec/ui` export, and they touch none of this diff's files.

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`: exit 0. `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2`: 77/77 tasks, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local`: 447 files, 8432 tests passed, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run`: 148 files, 6932 tests passed, exit 0.
- `typecheck`: objectql exit 0 and lint exit 0. Both include their `check:test-typecheck` leg.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derived 70 commands. All 70 ran on `a8614e4116` and exited 0. `--ran` reports 70 derived, 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- An earlier battery on `e5a2eecb0` had three non-zero exits, each resolved before the final run:
  - `check:error-code-casing` (exit 1): the new test literals asserted `code: 'rule_violation'` without the `field` key that marks them field-addressed. Fixed in `9b80c99f6`.
  - `check:engine-split-ratio` (exit 2): the shallow-clone refusal. Deepened with `git fetch --shallow-since=2026-07-14`.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET): missing dists. Ran after the full build.
- `test:repo` was not run locally. It is CI-owned, and this diff touches no `repo`-project test.

## Changeset

`.changeset/24512-conditional-when-hydration.md`:

- `@objectstack/objectql` `minor` and `@objectstack/lint` `minor`;
- `fix(objectql,lint)!:`, BREAKING (an accept-set narrowing at the save door and at write time), `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`;
- ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, accepted by `check-adr-0087-registration`;
- FROM / TO lines for each package and a "What to do".

## Deviations from the dispatch

- **`@objectstack/objectql` is `minor` BREAKING, not `patch`.** The write-time probe above measured a narrowing on that face. A write on an empty reference under a null-safe `when` (`.?`, `has()`, or an inline `!= null` test of the same reference) was judged by `otherwise` before. Now it is refused. Precedent for an objectql write-time narrowing: the `8d8f965` entry, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, minor.
- **The triage premise holds in part.** "Hydration admits nothing new at the door, and it makes a write that is refused today evaluate" is true for the plain spelling. It is not the whole effect:
  - the null-safe spellings silently took the wrong branch on every set reference before (now corrected);
  - they took `otherwise` on an empty reference (now refused, as above).
- **Rulings kept.** The route is unchanged: hydrate `when` as `checkPredicate` hydrates a condition, with the same helpers and no new resolver.
- **No dogfood pin.** A booted pin is outside the claim's file surface (`packages/qa/dogfood` is `domain:cli`). The envelope is asserted at the engine (`code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED'` plus per-field `code` and `constraint`) and at the save-door pass (`rule: 'expression-invalid'`). The HTTP statuses (`400` on the data door, `422 INVALID_METADATA` on the save door) are the existing mappings and were not re-measured on a booted stack here.

## Acceptance notes

- A `when` now follows a condition's rules for an empty reference. No single-expression spelling skips a rule while the reference is empty. The guard is its own `when`, as the refusal says. This is the platform's existing stance for conditions, now applied to `when`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` carries no `when`-hop pin. The save-door pass is pinned in lint's runtime-gate test, which is the body the door runs. Not added here.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test:repo` was not run. `packages/core`'s per-file census already has rows for both edited source files, and CI's `Test Core` runs it.
